name: cjiang-fnr
title: FNR series: wire-wound, magnetic-resin shielded SMD power inductors, 2.5×2.0 to 8×8 mm

source.document: Wire Wound SMD Power Inductors – FNR Series

summary: A family of surface-mount power inductors, each a winding on a ferrite core with metallised electrodes plated onto the core and a coating of magnetic resin closing the flux path, which keeps stray field and audible buzz low. It comes in 26 body sizes from 2.5×2.0×1.0 mm to 8.0×8.0×6.5 mm and 591 catalogue values from 0.22 µH to 15000 µH, at ±10, ±20 or ±30 % tolerance. Each value is given with maximum and typical DC resistance, minimum self-resonant frequency, and maximum and typical saturation (30 % inductance drop) and heating (40 °C rise) currents. It runs from -40 to +125 °C including its own heating.
key_figures: L at 100 kHz, 1 V (0.25 V for FNR3021S, 4015S, 5015S, 5030S); 20 °C ambient

notes: Every part number ends in T, the taped packing code.

pins.function: One end of the winding: a metallised electrode on the underside of the body at one edge.
Other end of the winding: the electrode on the opposite edge of the underside.

operation.text: The winding sits on a ferrite core whose electrodes are metallised directly on the core, which makes the part resistant to shock and drops. Magnetic resin coats the winding and closes the magnetic circuit, so leakage flux, EMI and audible buzz are low.

Two currents are given per value. Isat is where inductance has dropped about 30 % from its no-current value; Irms is the DC current that raises the part 40 °C above a 20 °C ambient. The part's rated current is the lower of the two. All figures are referenced to 20 °C ambient.
Inductance is measured at 100 kHz and 1 V, except the FNR3021S, FNR4015S, FNR5015S and FNR5030S series, measured at 100 kHz and 0.25 V, and FNR8050S103MT, measured at 1 kHz.
The operating range is -40 °C to +125 °C, and it includes the part's own temperature rise.
Every series except FNR252010S, 252012S, 3010S, 3012S, 3015S and 3021S carries its inductance code on top (for example 100 for 10 µH). All parts are supplied on tape.

Intended for power conversion in phones, smart TVs, set-top boxes, notebooks, car navigation, telecom base stations, VR/AR headsets, LED lighting, SSDs, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi modules, NB-IoT modules, headsets and smart speakers.

packages.name: FNR series body and recommended land pattern
notes: A and B: the two sides of the square (or 2.5×2.0 rectangular) body; C: overall height, a maximum.
D, E, F are seen from below: D is the width of each of the two end electrodes, E the length of each electrode from the body edge inward, F the gap between the two electrodes.
The last three columns are the recommended land pattern, typical: A Typ. is the gap a between the two pads, B Typ. the pad length b along the line joining them, C Typ. the pad width c across it.
Fig.1 (2520 sizes) is a rectangular body with notched corners; Fig.2 a square body with cut corners; Fig.3 a square body with a rounded octagonal top.
Every series is marked with its inductance code on top except FNR252010S, FNR252012S, FNR3010S, FNR3012S, FNR3015S and FNR3021S.
